name: Tensley Syrah Colson Canyon Vineyard 2018
text:
## Tensley Syrah Colson Canyon Vineyard 2018

**The story.** Joey Tensley grew up a Bakersfield farm boy and took a daring plunge into winemaking, launching his label in 1998. Wine Access writes that he "has pulled in more 94- to 99-point scores from Robert Parker than any other American Syrah-maker" ([Wine Access](https://www.wineaccess.com/catalog/2018-tensley-syrah-colson-canyon-santa-barbara_45881885-64da-4ab2-b01d-9282bc2454df)).

**The vineyard: Colson Canyon.** Colson Canyon is in the hills above [Los Olivos](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Los+Olivos,+California,+USA&t=k) in [Santa Barbara County](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Santa_Barbara_County,_California). Tensley first saw it in 1997, when it was freshly planted, and became the founder's first client ([Wine Access](https://www.wineaccess.com/catalog/2018-tensley-syrah-colson-canyon-santa-barbara_45881885-64da-4ab2-b01d-9282bc2454df)).

**The vintage.** [Jancis Robinson](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jancis_Robinson)'s [northern California vintage chart](https://www.jancisrobinson.com/learn/vintages/northern-california) says early rain gave vines a healthy start in 2018, then a cool autumn allowed prolonged ripening; "throughout the state", generally good-quality wines with good ageing potential.

**What the critics say for 2018.** As quoted by [Wine Access](https://www.wineaccess.com/catalog/2018-tensley-syrah-colson-canyon-santa-barbara_45881885-64da-4ab2-b01d-9282bc2454df):
- **[Jeb Dunnuck](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jeb_Dunnuck): 96 to 98**. "The deepest colored Syrah in the lineup": blackberries, toasted spice, herbs, peppered meat and earth; full-bodied, layered and tannic with a huge finish. "A magical Syrah from Tensley, and my money is on it being the finest to date."
- **[Vinous](https://vinous.com): 94 to 96**. "A flat-out gorgeous beauty": inky blue and purple fruit, lavender, spice and menthol, "positively stellar".
- Wine Access adds that Wine Spectator placed it at #40 in its Top 100 of 2020.
- **[CellarTracker](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CellarTracker) community: 91.5** (from your CellarTracker list).

**How it's drinking now.** In October 2026 the wine is eight years old. Dense and tannic when young, it should be opening now: blackberry, smoked meat, pepper and spice. Decant one to two hours ahead.

**Food.** Smoked brisket, Santa Maria-style tri-tip, lamb, or grilled sausages.

**Value and where to buy.** None of the stores on this site lists Tensley at the moment.

Sources:
- [Wine Access, 2018 Tensley Colson Canyon](https://www.wineaccess.com/catalog/2018-tensley-syrah-colson-canyon-santa-barbara_45881885-64da-4ab2-b01d-9282bc2454df)
